rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a republic as a state without a monarch.

example.english: This republic has no emperor; the head of state is elected by the people.
example.traditional: 呢個共和國冇皇帝，國家元首由人民選出。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung6 wo4 gwok3 mou5 wong4 dai3 gwok3 gaa1 jyun4 sau2 jau4 jan4 man4 syun2 ceot1

rows.note: Use this mainly for the Republic of China or for a republican-era state, not as the default general term.

example.english: In the early years of the republic, this place still preserved many old buildings.
example.traditional: 民國初年，呢度仲保留住好多舊建築。
example.jyutping: man4 gwok3 co1 nin4 ni1 dou6 zung6 bou2 lau4 zyu6 hou2 do1 gau6 gin3 zuk1
